C5: Cross-version pattern solidifies: v11/v2/v4 all fail to separate sham (sham near or above A-full); only v3 (anti-template) separates sham but over-triggers on real runs. v11's specificity-fingerprint test (added in v11 iteration) is the only rule that succeeded — confirming the iteration history's endpoint.
iteration_summary: v2(density)→v3(anti-template)→v4(anti-spin)→...→v11(specificity fingerprint): 10 iterations. v3 solved sham but broke real runs; v4 fixed the breakage but lost sham separation; v11 found the right signal (specificity quantity, not structure/template/URL presence). Full-matrix sweeps for v3/v4 provide quantitative evidence supporting v11 as the validated endpoint.
